page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.24xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine based on KVM virtualization. It is driven by AMD EPYC 9T24 processors utilizing the x86_64 architecture, providing 96 dedicated vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 384.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance configuration lacks dedicated GPUs, containing 0 GPU accelerators.

Storage and network topologies rely on network-attached infrastructure. The instance features no integrated local storage, requiring workloads to employ remote block storage volumes for persistent data. For network-level transport, ecs.g8a.24xlarge delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, but provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses upon provisioning, necessitating appropriate external networking setups.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation offers balanced operational capacity across a massive 96-core footprint. By scaling horizontally across high compute density without bundling expensive local NVMe or GPU hardware, this instance delivers high resource density for enterprise-grade execution. Best-fit use cases include enterprise web clusters, large-scale multi-threaded processing, relational and in-memory databases, continuous integration pipelines, and generic microservice backends.
